about: Azeroth Survivors' own item details (the armory's Details pages), transcribed from screenshots. Rings and trinkets: what a new one gives at each rarity, and how picking it again grows it. Amulets: a fixed rarity and their lines; offered again while worn, they grow toward three times their own numbers. Render with: node tools/build-items.js
